details: Bitcoin (BTC) has been trading around the $60,000 mark, experiencing slight fluctuations, but a significant trend of net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs persists. These outflows, totaling hundreds of millions of dollars, indicate weakening institutional demand and put downward pressure on the price, pushing it towards its lowest levels since 2024.
title: Bitcoin Struggles Below $60K Amid ETF Outflows

details: The Ethereum Foundation has announced a 20% reduction in its workforce, eliminating 54 positions. This restructuring comes as Ethereum (ETH) has seen a significant year-to-date decline of 44% despite record network usage, with the price dropping below $1,600 in the last 24 hours.
title: Ethereum Foundation Cuts Staff by 20% as ETH Price Dips

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance has notified users in the European Union of a suspension of certain operations after failing to secure its Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) license before the compliance deadline. A report indicates that only 17% of previously registered crypto firms successfully gained full authorization under the new MiCA framework, highlighting strict regulatory adherence requirements.
title: Binance Suspends EU Operations Due to MiCA Licensing Failure

details: Kraken, a major cryptocurrency exchange, is reportedly in discussions to acquire a 15% stake in the decentralized finance (DeFi) lending protocol Aave, valuing the lender at $385 million. However, Aave's founder has publicly denied claims of a 70% discounted sale.
title: Kraken Reportedly Eyes Stake in DeFi Lender Aave

details: Russia has established a loophole for selected firms to legally use cryptocurrencies amidst sanctions. While this provides a legal route for certain entities, the cash-out mechanisms remain ringfenced, implying continued restrictions on broader access to convert crypto to traditional currency.
title: Russia Creates Crypto Sanctions Loophole, But Cash-Out Routes Restricted
